name: ChatExport component
description: The user wants to export a chat using the `$projects.exportChat` function with parameters `chat` and `exportFormat`. They need to find the chat project using `chat.project_id` in the project store and then use the project's API to call `$api.chats.export` with parameters `{ id, exportFormat }`.

messages.content: Create the vuejs export component and let user select the type of document to export

Call $projects.exportChat with the chat and the export format as object { chat, exportFormat }
In project store find the chat project (chat.project_id) and use it's api to call $api.chats.export({ id, exportFormat })
